description: This file defines interfaces for an Application Gateway within the WPEFramework project, including resolver, authenticator, responder, request handler, telemetry, and notification interfaces, as well as related data structures.
external_methods: Core::hresult Resolve(const GatewayContext& context, const string& origin, const string& method, const string& params, string& result)
Core::hresult Authenticate(const string& sessionId, string& appId)
Core::hresult GetSessionId(const string& appId, string& sessionId)
Core::hresult CheckPermissionGroup(const string& appId, const string& permissionGroup, bool& allowed)
Core::hresult Respond(const GatewayContext& context, const string& payload)
Core::hresult Emit(const GatewayContext& context, const string& method, const string& payload)
Core::hresult Request(const uint32_t connectionId, const uint32_t id, const string& method, const string& params)
Core::hresult GetGatewayConnectionContext(const uint32_t connectionId, const string& contextKey, string& contextValue)
Core::hresult HandleAppGatewayRequest(const GatewayContext& context, const string& method, const string& payload, string& result)
Core::hresult RecordTelemetryEvent(const GatewayContext& context, const string& eventName, const string& eventData)
Core::hresult RecordTelemetryMetric(const GatewayContext& context, const string& metricName, const double metricValue, const string& metricUnit)

classes.name: GatewayContext
classes.description: Structure representing the context of a gateway request, including request ID, connection ID, and application ID.

classes.name: IAppGatewayResolver
classes.description: Interface for resolving application gateways, including configuration and resolution methods.

classes.name: IAppGatewayAuthenticator
classes.description: Interface for authenticating connections and checking permissions.

classes.name: IAppGatewayResponder
classes.description: Interface for sending responses, emitting notifications, forwarding requests, and accessing connection context.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for app connection changes, to be registered with the responder.

classes.name: IAppGatewayRequestHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling specific app gateway requests.

classes.name: IAppGatewayTelemetry
classes.description: Interface for recording telemetry events and metrics.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Adds additional resolution paths to the gateway.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a request given its context, origin, method, and parameters.

methods.name: Authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates an incoming connection based on session ID.

methods.name: GetSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the session ID for a given application ID.

methods.name: CheckPermissionGroup
methods.description: Checks whether an application belongs to a specific permission group.

methods.name: Respond
methods.description: Sends a response payload for a given context.

methods.name: Emit
methods.description: Emits a notification to a specific context.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Forwards a request to the client with given method and parameters.

methods.name: HandleAppGatewayRequest
methods.description: Handles a specific app gateway request.

methods.name: RecordTelemetryEvent
methods.description: Records a telemetry event with associated gateway context.

methods.name: RecordTelemetryMetric
methods.description: Records a telemetry metric with associated gateway context.

methods.name: void OnAppConnectionChanged(const string & appId,const uint32_t connectionId,const bool connected)
